profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | Software Engineer | Scalable SaaS | Python · Typescript · AWS ·
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable software across backend, full-stack, and product environments.

I like taking complicated, ambiguous problems and turning them into simple, scalable systems. Whether I am designing an API, refactoring an application, or building a new feature from incomplete requirements, I focus on making software easier to scale, test, maintain, and ship.

I have worked on government technology serving 340M+ users and supported platforms serving 1,200+ organizations and over 100,000 users, designed and maintained REST and GraphQL APIs, worked across backend and frontend systems, and improved architectures to make teams faster and software more reliable.

I am at my best in fast-paced environments where I can take ownership, make technical decisions, and turn ideas into working products. I combine hands-on engineering with product thinking while taking ownership of technical decisions and building toward technical leadership and founding-engineer roles.

Skills (to name a few) :
Programming Languages: Python | Java | JavaScript | TypeScript | React | Angular | Flutter. 
Systems:  FastAPI | REST APIs | GraphQL | Microservices | Distributed Systems | Redis | Kafka.
Database & CI/CD:  MySQL | DynamoDB | AWS | Docker | Terraform | Git | Azure Devops.

If you are building a product, scaling a system, or tackling a difficult engineering problem, feel free to reach out. I always welcome conversations with recruiters, hiring managers, founders, and engineering teams.

📧 kapishmanojpatel@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack
positions.description:
Building government technology Software as a Service platform providing core digital infrastructure for public sector administration and municipal services.

• Designed and developed full-stack application supporting 1,200+ local governments and 340M+ residents, integrating Auth, Documents, Analytical and other services to deliver features from concept to production.

• Enhanced the reliability of payment services processing $1B+ in annual transactions, reducing transaction failure rates from approximately 5% to near zero by resolving void gaps that impacted payment completion.

• Increased accounting system reliability by expanding unit and integration test coverage for critical financial workflows, contributing to a 20% reduction in accounting-related support tickets within a single quarter.

• Led frontend accessibility features across core application modules, delivering ADA/WCAG-compliant UI updates across multiple user-facing workflows and meeting strict compliance deadlines.

• Optimized a high-throughput service handling 700K+ weekly requests by implementing a scheduling algorithm, reducing processing latency from ~2.5s to ~200–300ms in a critical execution path.

• Refactored legacy forms system into a modern, extensible component architecture, leveraging AI development tools like github copilot and Claude to accelerate refactoring, and enabling new capabilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack
positions.description:
Early-stage sports technology startup developing a community marketplace that connects players, organizes local pickup games, and simplifies athletic event management.

• Designed and implemented scalable full-stack architecture using React and Supabase, defining data models, API structure, and authentication flows to support evolving product requirements.

• Contributed across product scoping, development, and QA to bring initial product features from concept to production.

• Led onboarding of 10 initial test users within the first month, collected structured feedback, and iteratively improved product features in close collaboration with the founder to refine early product direction.

positions.title: Information Technology System Technician
positions.description:
University-wide IT & AV Infrastructure Engineering supporting smart classroom technology, campus-wide systems integration, and live event media production across university facilities.

• Delivered technical support for campus facilities, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues across classrooms and event spaces for faculty, staff, and students.

• Installed, configured, and maintained computers, projectors, audio/video systems, microphones, speakers, gaming consoles, and streaming equipment for campus operations and live events.

• Executed live event production for 50+ events per semester, managing audio mixing, camera operation, and video streaming to ensure reliable event delivery.

• Managed IT asset inventories, deployed operating system images, and troubleshot technical issues across Linux, Windows, and macOS environments.

• Diagnosed network outages, reset user credentials, and resolved IT service requests to improve response times and user satisfaction.

• Integrated classroom technologies, including smart boards, presentation systems, and audiovisual equipment, to enable reliable instructional delivery.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant - Software as a Service
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant for Computer Science curriculum focused on cloud computing, web application architecture, and modern Software-as-a-Service design principles.

• Delivered lectures and lab sessions for a Software-as-a-Service course, teaching 50+ students SaaS architecture, cloud computing, and web application development.

• Mentored students in developing scalable web applications using Java, Node.js, React, and cloud platforms, reinforcing software engineering best practices.

• Evaluated assignments, reviewed projects, and assessed code quality, strengthening student proficiency in object-oriented programming, design patterns, and test-driven development (TDD).

• Streamlined automated grading and debugging workflows, reducing instructor workload by 30% while ensuring timely feedback on student projects.

• Facilitated review sessions and individualized mentoring, improving student project success rates and overall class satisfaction.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mission-critical Banking SaaS platform providing enterprise financial infrastructure, high-availability transaction processing, and multi-tenant solutions for financial institutions.

• Architected and maintained a high-throughput Java API processing over 4.2 million banking transactions daily with 99.99% uptime, leveraging software engineering patterns to eliminate single points of failures.

• Engineered on-prem infrastructure for 18 bank tenants, implementing PostgreSQL HA clusters and a geo-separated DR site that streamlined RTO from 4 hours to 22 minutes.

• Designed and implemented an authentication and authorization platform with OAuth 2.0, JWT hardening, RBAC, and automated audit evidence collection, reducing audit preparation time by 60%.

• Owned 9 production services in a 24/7 banking environment, reducing incidents by 35% through improved alerting, synthetic monitoring, and post-mortem driven runbooks.

• Re-engineered low-latency API endpoints for core banking workflows reducing average p95 response time from 220 ms to 80 ms under peak load improving SLA compliance from 91% to 99.3% for 6 contracted banks.
